scripts.github-dev-build: npm install && composer install && npm run dev-build
scripts.prezip: npm install && npm run build && npm run docs-build && composer install --no-dev
scripts.zip: zip -r studip-timesheet-v$npm_package_version.zip controllers dist docs lib migrations vendor views LICENSE LICENSE-SUPPLEMENT.txt README.md StudipTimesheet.php bootstrap.php plugin.manifest -x '*.editorconfig' -x 'vendor/*.git*' -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.docs-build: npx @redocly/cli build-docs docs/api/openapi.yaml -o docs/api/api-docs.html && npm run docs-compliance
scripts.docs-compliance: mkdir -p docs/compliance && npm sbom --sbom-format spdx --json > docs/compliance/sbom.json && npm audit --json > docs/compliance/security-audit.json
